title: FortiGate — NOC Overview
description: Full-stack FortiGate monitoring: SD-WAN link health, per-interface throughput, firewall policies, and UTM security events (IPS / Web Filter / SSL Inspection). Requires two data sources: Prometheus with prometheus-community/fortigate_exporter, and Loki fed by FortiGate syslog (rsyslog -> Grafana Alloy). Log panels expect the labels job="fortigate" plus type/subtype/level/action; all other fields are parsed at query time with | logfmt.
